card.name: drommarna-fran-tjaro
card.title: Drömmarna från Tjärö
card.description: SSWC-boken 2010 (red. Mattias Boström): 181 texter från Sweden Social Web Camp på Tjärö, återutgivna 2026 som ett signerat, agent-läsbart arkiv. Innehåller DÅ/IDAG-dossierer för 183 författare, 181 drömmar bedömda mot 2026, 9 teman, 178 AI-brev från framtida jag, samt 41 författarfigurer skannade ur boken.
card.license_posture: Per-författare upphovsrätt 2010 · återpublicerad i delningens anda · INTE Creative Commons · invändningar tas emot på joakim@jardenberg.com och rättas inom 24 timmar.

signing.wrapper_shape: { iat: <unix seconds>, payload: <result data>, payload_digest: "sha256:<hex over RFC 8785 canonical payload>", content_digest: "sha256:<hex over the exact bytes of the text arm as served>", provenance: {...} }

envelope.location: result._meta["org.jardenberg/verifiable-mcp"] on tools/call and resources/read; error.data["org.jardenberg/verifiable-mcp"] on JSON-RPC error responses
envelope.note: Both digests live INSIDE the signed wrapper. Any value mirrored outside the JWS is convenience-only and never security-bearing.

signing.content_binding: By digest: hash the exact bytes of the text arm as served (tools/call result.content[0].text, resources/read result.contents[0].text) and compare with content_digest inside the signed wrapper.
signing.error_payload_shape: { id: <request id>, error: { code, message, data? } }; error wrappers carry iat + payload + payload_digest + provenance only — content_digest is omitted because no text arm is served for errors. Invalid arguments use JSON-RPC code -32602.
signing.server_card_path_note: The /.well-known/mcp.json server-card path follows SEP-2127, which is not yet frozen upstream — the path may change. Both the card and the dedicated key file are served.
signing.response_format: JWS compact (RFC 7515), protected header {alg:"EdDSA", kid, typ:"verifiable-mcp+jws"}, over the RFC 8785 canonical wrapper.

deprecated.signature: v0.1 `signature` + `provenance` sibling fields on result are still emitted for transition and will be removed in v0.3.

signing.structured_content: structuredContent is byte-identical to the signed wrapper.payload (RFC 8785). The deprecated v0.1 provenance and signature objects are top-level siblings of result, never inside structuredContent.
